$schema: Backend Completion Plan Stage 6 — curated idiom fallbacks for the Tomo daily note. Keyed by JLPT level; the service picks deterministically by (userId, dateKey) hash so a learner gets the same idiom for the same day across retries.

N5.body: 一日一歩 (いちにちいっぽ) — one step a day. Showing up is the streak; pace is the long game.
千里の道も一歩から (せんりのみちもいっぽから). A journey of a thousand ri begins with a single step. Today's review is that step.
急がば回れ (いそがばまわれ). When in a hurry, take the longer route. Slow reviews now save fast ones later.
好きこそ物の上手なれ (すきこそもののじょうずなれ). What you love, you grow good at. Pick a deck you actually enjoy.

N4.body: 継続は力なり (けいぞくはちからなり). Persistence becomes strength. The cards you reviewed last week are why today feels lighter.
雨垂れ石を穿つ (あまだれいしをうがつ). A constant drip wears the stone through. Small daily reviews beat occasional cramming.
石の上にも三年 (いしのうえにもさんねん). Three years even on a cold stone. Mastery takes the time it takes.
失敗は成功のもと (しっぱいはせいこうのもと). Failure is the seed of success — every lapse is data, not a verdict.

N3.body: 案ずるより産むが易し (あんずるよりうむがやすし). The dread of doing it is heavier than the doing. Start the queue and the rest follows.
急いては事を仕損じる (せいてはことをしそんじる). Haste spoils the work. Read the sentence twice before rating.
猿も木から落ちる (さるもきからおちる). Even monkeys fall from trees. A mis-rated card is a working day, not a failed one.
我慢の上に花が咲く (がまんのうえにはながさく). Flowers bloom on patience. The interval that feels stuck today opens up next week.

N2.body: 塵も積もれば山となる (ちりもつもればやまとなる). Even dust, when it gathers, becomes a mountain. Five minutes a day is the mountain.
鉄は熱いうちに打て (てつはあついうちにうて). Strike the iron while it's hot — review the cards that feel uncertain today, not next week.
案じるより慣れろ (あんじるよりなれろ). Better to get used to it than to worry about it. The N2 grammar you keep dodging will soften with reps.
井の中の蛙大海を知らず (いのなかのかわずたいかいをしらず). The frog in the well knows nothing of the great sea. Try a deck outside your comfort domain this week.

N1.body: 知識は力なり (ちしきはちからなり). Knowledge is power — but only knowledge that's been used. Today's review is the using.
温故知新 (おんこちしん). Study the old to know the new. Rolling back to a half-forgotten N3 deck for a week often clarifies an N1 pattern.
聞くは一時の恥、聞かぬは一生の恥 (きくはいっときのはじ、きかぬはいっしょうのはじ). Asking is a moment of shame; not asking, a lifetime's. Look up the kanji compound you've been guessing at.
百聞は一見に如かず (ひゃくぶんはいっけんにしかず). A hundred hearings are less than one seeing. Read a paragraph of real text today, even if you only understand half.

beyond_jlpt.body: 蛍雪の功 (けいせつのこう). The merit of fireflies and snow — those who studied by their faint light. Quiet hours are the productive ones.
守破離 (しゅはり). Protect the form, break the form, leave the form. You're past mimicry; let the rules bend where the meaning is clearer.
言わぬが花 (いわぬがはな). The unspoken is the flower. Some words are clearer in what they refuse to say — practice noticing the omission.
縁は異なもの (えんはいなもの). Connection is a strange thing. The word you can't shake from a song lyric is the one to learn first.
